title: Independent MTBS event corroboration

attributes.comments: Fire severity could be misrepresented in wetland areas.

reference_manifest.reference: Landsat/Sentinel-2 postfire burned-area mapping with incident attributes
reference_manifest.limitations: Large mapped fires only; omitted/unmapped/small events are not negatives. Ignition dates do not specify fire cessation or pixel burning time.

interpretation: Mapped-event corroboration only. A report inside the eventual burned perimeter is not proof it detected that specific event. Reference dates are day-resolution, windows are [ignition, ignition + N days), incomplete/small/unmapped fires are not negatives, and no precision/recall or true detection-latency claim is made.
